name: gptvis-recharts-workspace
description: Monorepo for the GPT-Vis Recharts adapter and its playground.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w gptvis-recharts && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.build: npm run build -w gptvis-recharts && npm run build -w playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w gptvis-recharts && npm run build -w gptvis-recharts && npm run typecheck -w playground
